tools.title: Official Unreal MCP
tools.summary: Epic's native MCP server and Toolset Registry bridge. This should be the primary AI transport layer for UE 5.8+.
why: AICallable tool discovery through Toolset Registry
Works with MCP-compatible agents such as Codex
workflow: Enable ModelContextProtocol and ToolsetRegistry plugins.
Start the MCP server from Unreal Editor.
Connect Codex using the generated MCP configuration.
Prefer tool calls over UI automation when a native tool exists.
tools.codex: Foundation layer. Our plugin should extend it rather than create a parallel protocol server.
tools.caution: Experimental API surface can change between engine versions; pin the supported Unreal version and verify tool discovery after upgrades.

tools.title: Unreal MCP Tools (this repository)
tools.summary: Our production-oriented extension layer for Blueprint inspection, graph mutation, validation and Codex workflows.
workflow: Install Plugin/UnrealMCPTools into the game project.
Enable official Unreal MCP dependencies.
Run environment checks.
Inspect before mutating.
Compile, validate, re-read, then explicitly save.
tools.codex: Primary custom toolset layer. Add project-specific tools here only when Epic does not already expose them.
tools.caution: Must be built with UHT/UBT in a real UE 5.8 editor target before being treated as verified.

tools.title: Slate Inspector Toolset
tools.summary: Playwright-style automation for Unreal Editor Slate UI: snapshots, screenshots, clicks, typing, drag, wait and form filling.
why: Lets Codex operate editor UI when no native API exists
Useful for editor plugins and custom tools
workflow: Observe the target window/panel.
Snapshot the widget tree.
Use refs for click/type/select/drag.
Wait for expected UI state.
Take a screenshot when visual evidence matters.
Unobserve when done.
tools.codex: Fallback lane after native MCP/API tools. Excellent for UMG/editor workflow smoke tests.
tools.caution: Do not use UI automation when a deterministic native tool exists; UI labels and layouts are more fragile.

tools.title: Automation Test MCP Toolset
tools.summary: Epic MCP toolset that discovers, runs, stops and retrieves Unreal Automation Framework test results.
why: Codex can execute real Unreal tests
workflow: DiscoverTests once per session.
ListTests using name/tag filters.
RunTests or RunTestsByFilter.
Poll GetTestStatus.
Read GetTestResults and fix failures.
tools.codex: Use as the standard post-change verification lane for editor/gameplay code and content tests.
tools.caution: Discovery is asynchronous and can take time; do not repeatedly rediscover unless tests changed.

tools.title: Live Coding MCP Toolset
tools.summary: Triggers Unreal Live Coding compilation and returns compiler diagnostics directly to MCP clients.
workflow: Enable Live Coding in Editor Preferences.
Make a small C++ change.
Call CompileLiveCoding.
Inspect errors/warnings.
Use a full editor rebuild when reflection/layout changes require it.
tools.codex: Use for short compile/fix loops; pair with AutomationTestToolset after successful compilation.
tools.caution: Live Coding is not a substitute for a clean UBT/UHT rebuild after UCLASS/USTRUCT/UFUNCTION signature or module-level changes.

tools.title: Python Editor Scripting
tools.summary: Unreal's embedded Python lane for asset processing, editor automation and pipeline integration.
workflow: Enable Python Editor Script Plugin and Editor Scripting Utilities.
Keep scripts editor-only.
Use Python for bulk deterministic operations.
Promote stable critical behavior to C++ when stronger typing/API coverage is required.
tools.codex: Good implementation lane for generated one-off or project pipeline scripts, especially content operations.
tools.caution: Python API coverage differs from C++; do not force graph authoring through Python when editor C++ APIs are more reliable.

tools.title: Editor Utility Widgets
tools.summary: Dockable UMG-based editor tools for project-specific buttons, dashboards and workflows.
why: Can wrap repetitive project actions in a friendly UI
workflow: Create an Editor Utility Widget.
Keep runtime and editor responsibilities separate.
Expose project operations as buttons/forms.
Use MCP or Slate Inspector to drive it when agent automation is useful.
tools.codex: Codex can create/support EUWs and later drive them through Slate Inspector when a direct tool call is not available.
tools.caution: Do not hide important business logic only inside UI graphs; keep reusable logic in functions/subsystems/libraries.

tools.title: Scriptable Tools System
tools.summary: Blueprint-accessible Interactive Tools Framework for building custom viewport interaction tools and editor modes.
workflow: Enable Scriptable Tools Editor Mode.
Create an editor-only Scriptable Tool Blueprint.
Expose focused user interactions.
Use transactions for asset/world mutations.
tools.codex: Useful when the optimal workflow needs a human-in-the-loop viewport tool rather than a hidden command.
tools.caution: This is for editor tooling, not runtime gameplay.

tools.title: ZiggyMar / unreal-mcp
tools.summary: Community Unreal MCP bridge with Blueprint graph editing, project indexing and node catalog ideas worth studying.
workflow: Use as a reference implementation.
Port only the ideas/API patterns we need.
Prefer Epic's official MCP transport on UE 5.8.
Do not duplicate overlapping servers.
tools.codex: Architecture reference for deeper graph tooling and project indexing.
tools.caution: Third-party implementation; do not couple our production path to it when the official MCP layer covers transport.

tools.title: SunGrow Blueprint Extractor
tools.summary: Blueprint and StateTree extraction/authoring system with a large machine-friendly MCP contract.
why: Useful design ideas for read/verify/save workflows
workflow: Study its resource schemas and extraction model.
Borrow machine-friendly representation ideas.
Keep explicit-save semantics.
Port features only after checking UE 5.8 APIs.
tools.codex: Reference for richer asset/resource representations and StateTree support.
tools.caution: Treat compatibility and validation claims as repository-specific; verify against the target editor build.

tools.title: UnrealAIAssistant
tools.summary: Editor-integrated AI panel supporting Codex/Claude plus MCP tools for assets, Blueprints, materials, characters and viewport capture.
workflow: Study the editor panel and task orchestration UX.
Do not vendor blindly because its documented baseline is UE 5.5.
Port useful concepts into our 5.8-native layer.
tools.codex: Reference for an optional dockable assistant experience inside Unreal.
tools.caution: Version baseline differs from ours; editor APIs may need migration.

tools.title: UE Node2Code
tools.summary: Exports Material and Niagara node graphs into compact text that is easier for AI agents to reason about.
why: Useful when our native graph readers do not cover a graph type
workflow: Install as a project plugin if compatible.
Export the target graph.
Feed compact text to Codex for analysis.
Apply edits through Unreal-native APIs/editor tools.
tools.codex: Useful read-only bridge for graph types beyond standard Blueprints.
tools.caution: Prefer native structured readers once our MCP plugin supports the same graph type.

tools.title: UAssetAPI
tools.summary: Low-level .NET library for reading and writing Unreal assets outside the editor.
why: Useful for forensic or pipeline tasks when Unreal Editor is unavailable
workflow: Use primarily for inspection/extraction.
Keep production Blueprint semantic writes inside Unreal Editor.
Pin the Unreal asset version before parsing/writing.
Validate any generated assets by opening them in Unreal.
tools.codex: Fallback offline asset-inspection lane, not the normal production mutation path.
tools.caution: Direct binary asset writes bypass Unreal editor invariants and compilation; use with strict safeguards.

tools.title: PCG MCP Toolset
tools.summary: Epic toolset that lets an AI assistant build and modify PCG graphs using AICallable Unreal-native operations.
why: Creates and edits PCG graph nodes through Unreal APIs
Exposes graph structure and node schemas to agents
Pairs naturally with the official Unreal MCP server
workflow: Enable PCG, PCGToolset, ToolsetRegistry and ModelContextProtocol.
Ask the agent to inspect the graph before modification.
Use native PCG tool calls to add nodes/subgraphs and parameters.
Execute/validate the graph and inspect generated output before saving.
tools.codex: Prefer this official toolset over adding duplicate PCG mutation methods to UnrealMCPTools.
tools.caution: The PCGToolset plugin is Experimental in UE 5.8. Pin the engine version and smoke-test tool contracts after upgrades.
